name: LongMemEval-V2
summary: Evaluates long-term agent memory over large histories of multimodal web-agent trajectories in customized web and enterprise environments.
scale: 451 curated questions; up to 500 trajectories per haystack; largest haystacks up to 115M tokens
measurement_strength: Moves beyond chat-history recall toward memory over accumulated agent experience.
coverage_gap: Downstream QA remains a proxy for whether memory improves future closed-loop task execution.

name: SGR-Bench
summary: Benchmarks state-gated retrieval where useful evidence is accessible only after an agent configures site-specific filters, views, hierarchies, or scopes.
scale: 100 expert-curated tasks across six source families and 12 public data ecosystems
measurement_strength: Separates reaching a relevant source from establishing the correct retrieval state inside that source.
coverage_gap: The benchmark targets a specific retrieval regime and should not be treated as a universal proxy for open-web research or document RAG.

name: Data Agent Benchmark (DAB)
summary: Evaluates realistic enterprise data agents on complex questions spanning multiple databases, awkward joins, text transformation, and domain knowledge.
measurement_strength: Pushes data-agent evaluation beyond SQL-only and single-database tasks.
coverage_gap: Leaderboard scores can entangle model, hints, retries/trials, and the surrounding agent harness.

name: FDABench
summary: Evaluates data agents on heterogeneous analytical queries with multiple task forms, databases, and unstructured sources.
scale: 2,007 tasks across multiple domains, difficulty levels, and report/choice task types
measurement_strength: Exposes answer quality together with latency and token cost across heterogeneous analytical workflows.
coverage_gap: Task breadth does not by itself identify which agent component caused success or failure.

name: AgenticRAGTracer
summary: A hop-aware benchmark for diagnosing multi-step retrieval reasoning rather than evaluating only final-answer correctness.
measurement_strength: Makes intermediate retrieval/reasoning failures observable at hop granularity.
coverage_gap: Automatically generated task structure can introduce artifacts, and annotated hops are not automatically causal agent steps.

name: RAGCap-Bench
summary: Capability-oriented benchmark for fine-grained evaluation of intermediate tasks in agentic RAG workflows.
scale: Capability-oriented evaluation suite derived from recurring tasks and error patterns in agentic RAG systems
measurement_strength: Separates intermediate agentic-RAG skills from final-answer accuracy.
coverage_gap: A capability score is useful only if it predicts realized end-to-end behavior under matched tools and budgets.

name: MemoryAgentBench
summary: Evaluates memory agents through incremental multi-turn interactions, including retrieval, conflict resolution, and test-time learning behaviors.
scale: Multiple benchmark families covering retrieval, conflict resolution, and test-time learning
measurement_strength: Broadens memory evaluation beyond static retrieval from a frozen conversation history.
coverage_gap: Cross-system comparison remains sensitive to the answerer LLM, embedding model, judge, and surrounding memory harness.
